description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在探討室內設計中的物理環境因素對空間品質和人的健康與舒適度的影響。透過理論探討、案例分析和實際操作，學生將學習室內環境的基本原理、設計方法和評估指標，並能夠運用物理環境知識進行設計方案的分析和優化。課程內容涵蓋照明設計、通風與空調、熱舒適、噪音控制等相關主題，期望培養學生對室內環境的理解和設計能力，提升其在設計領域的專業水準。
description.describe_eh: Explore the impact of physical environmental factors in interior design on spatial quality and human health and comfort. Through theoretical exploration, case analysis, and practical operation, students will learn the basic principles of the indoor environment, design methods, and evaluation indicators, and be able to use physical environment knowledge to analyze and optimize design schemes. The course content covers related topics such as lighting design, ventilation and air conditioning, thermal comfort, noise control, etc., with the expectation of cultivating students' understanding and design capabilities of the indoor environment, and enhancing their professional level in the design field.

targets.describe_ch: 理解室內環境的物理特性和相關理論，包括光線、溫度、空氣品質、聲音等因素。
targets.describe_en: Understand the physical characteristics and related theories of the indoor environment, including factors such as light, temperature, air quality, and sound.

targets.describe_ch: 掌握室內設計中的物理環境設計原則和方法，能夠根據使用需求和空間特性進行合理的環境設計。
targets.describe_en: Master the principles and methods of physical environment design in interior design, and be able to carry out reasonable environment design according to usage requirements and spatial characteristics.

targets.describe_ch: 學習使用各種工具和技術進行室內環境的評估和分析，了解環境品質對人的影響和相關標準。
targets.describe_en: Learn to use various tools and techniques to evaluate and analyze the indoor environment, understand the impact of environmental quality on people, and the related standards.

targets.describe_ch: 掌握照明、通風、空調等設計技術，能夠設計出符合舒適度和健康標準的室內環境。
targets.describe_en: Master the design techniques of lighting, ventilation, air conditioning, etc., and be able to design an indoor environment that meets comfort and health standards

targets.describe_ch: 學習將物理環境知識應用於實際設計中，能夠分析和解決實際設計中的物理環境問題。
targets.describe_en: Learn to apply physical environment knowledge to practical design, and be able to analyze and solve physical environment problems in actual design.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生的創新思維和解決問題的能力，能夠在團隊中充分發揮自己的專業技能，共同完成設計任務。
targets.describe_en: Cultivate students’ innovative thinking and problem-solving abilities, be able to fully demonstrate their professional skills in the team, and complete the design task togethe
